name: autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age
description: Maximum multixact age at which autovacuum triggers a VACUUM to prevent multixact ID wraparound in a table.
symptoms: Database shutdown due to wraparound risk
Autovacuum unable to prevent relminmxid exhaustion
Query failures with 'cannot assign multixact ID' errors
tuning_tips: Set higher than multixact_freeze_min_age but low enough to ensure autovacuum runs before relminmxid approaches wraparound; reduce under heavy multi-transaction workloads or when seeing wraparound warnings.
